newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent products differentials steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent products differentials steady.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gasoline differentials were steady in Chicago and Group Three, although traders said basis was difficult to guage in thin trade on Thursday.

The market on Friday was expected to focus on a court decision due late in the morning that will determine whether Clark Refining and Marketing Co can restart units idled at its 80,515 barrel per day Blue Island, Ill., refinery.
Illinois regulators sought an order shutting the refinery because of safety concerns, but the refiner said the facility has operated safely since a fatal accident in 1985.
Chicago unleaded for prompt November deliveries firmed to bids 8.50 cents a gallon over NYMEX December unleaded, with later deliveries firming to bids 6.25 cents over the print.
Group Three unleaded was steady at 5.0/5.25 cents a gallon over the print for prompt deliveries and 2.0/2.25 cents over for later deliveries.
Chicago low sulphur diesel was talked 3.50/3.75 cents over NYMEX December unleaded for prompt deliveries and 2.0/2.25 cents over for later deliveries.
Group Three low sulphur was talked 5.25/5.50 cents over the print for prompt deliveries and 1.75/2.0 cents over for later deliveries.
Distillate basis was seen weakening in the coming week, particularly in the Group, on barrels drawn to the market by the strong basis compared to the Gulf coast, traders said.
